S2.1-fix-zindex.title: Fix Z-INDEX do Filtro

technical_notes.approach: Increase z-index to >= 50, use position: absolute with parent position: relative
technical_notes.alternatives: Could use Popper.js (if installed) for smart positioning
technical_notes.edge_cases: Test dropdown repositioning at viewport edges, with scrolling

blocks: S2.2 (must be fixed before S2.2 works properly)

S2.1-fix-zindex.notes: Quick CSS fix. Critical blocker for S2.2, must be done first in Wave 2.

S2.2-status-filter.title: Add Filtro por Status no Kanban

technical_risks.filter_combination: MEDIUM - Must combine properly with other filters (assignee, labels, etc)
technical_risks.real_time_updates: Filter must update without page reload

blocked_by: S2.1 (Z-INDEX fix must be done first)

S2.2-status-filter.notes: Depends on S2.1. Must coordinate with existing filter system to avoid conflicts.

S3.1-drag-drop.title: Implementar Drag & Drop tipo Trello/ClickUp

scope_analysis.description: PipelineBoard, PipelineColumn, ContactPipelineCard, pipeline.js (API), controller, SCSS

technologies: Vuedraggable (if available) OR native drag events

performance_considerations.critical: VERY HIGH - Must handle 100+ cards without lag

technical_complexity.vue_challenge: Complex state management with drag state + persistence
technical_complexity.backend_challenge: Transaction safety when moving between stages
technical_complexity.ux_challenge: Visual feedback (shadow, drop zone, insertion line) must feel responsive
technical_complexity.browser_compat: Touch events for mobile/tablet, different behavior in Firefox vs Chrome

blocked_by: Wave 1 + Wave 2 (should not start until S2.2 complete)

S3.1-drag-drop.notes: LARGEST story by complexity. Performance-critical. Recommend vuedraggable if available, else native events. Firefox testing critical.

S4.1-deduplication.title: Resolver Duplicação de Cards

scope_analysis.description: Contact model, ContactDeduplicationService, DedupContactsJob, 2 migrations, actions, component

integration_points: Database schema (merged_to_id, is_merged, merge_reason, audit fields)
database_impact: Add columns: merged_to_id, is_merged, merge_reason, merged_at, merged_by_id
Add unique constraint: (account_id, phone_number, identifier) WHERE is_merged = false
Add index on merged_to_id and is_merged for query performance

data_integrity_risks.criticality: CRITICAL - Any data loss is unacceptable
risks: Moving conversations between contacts without validating relationships
Merging contacts that shouldn't be merged (false positives in similarity)
mitigations: Use soft deletes (mark as merged, don't delete)
Comprehensive audit trail (who merged, when, reason)
Backward compatibility - follow chain of merges
Test with real data before production

technical_complexity.algorithm: String similarity (Levenshtein) for name matching - need threshold (0.95+)
technical_complexity.migration: Huge dataset - need pagination/batching to avoid memory issues
technical_complexity.rollback: If merge detected as bad, need to unmerge (complex)

blocked_by: Wave 3 (should be done last for stability)

S4.1-deduplication.notes: MOST COMPLEX story. Data integrity is paramount. Recommend: staging environment dry-run, comprehensive testing, small batch rollout, monitoring immediately after.

frontend.stability: STABLE - All used extensively in project

backend.risk: MEDIUM (due to data operations in S4.1)

dependency_chain: S2.1 (Z-INDEX fix) → MUST BE DONE BEFORE S2.2
S1.1, S1.2, S1.3 (Wave 1) → Can be done in parallel
S2.1, S2.2 (Wave 2) → S2.1 MUST be first
critical_path_analysis.high_risk_blocker: S4.1 (Deduplication) - data integrity critical, longest story

adjustment_reason: +2 dias: S4.1 data integrity testing (critical risk)
timeline_adjustment.risk_buffer: Recommend 2-3 dias extra buffer for unknown unknowns

process: 1. Execute Wave 1 in parallel (S1.1, S1.2, S1.3 can overlap)
2. S2.1 MUST be first in Wave 2, then S2.2 (serial due to dependency)
3. Start Wave 3 (S3.1) only after Wave 1+2 complete
4. S4.1 must be last wave - highest risk, data integrity critical
5. 1 PR per story, do NOT combine waves in single PR
testing: Accessibility: Automated WCAG checker + manual Coblis testing for S1.1, S1.2
Performance: Lighthouse + browser profiler for S3.1 with 100+ cards
Data integrity: Comprehensive test suite for S4.1, dry-run on staging
Regression: Full test suite after each wave before proceeding
team_allocation: Avoid: Single dev on S3.1 + S4.1 together (too risky)
Timeline: 3-4 weeks with 1 dev, 2.5-3 weeks with 2 devs (parallel Wave 1)
